elements.title: Destination of the Month (Wikivoyage recommendations)
elements.contents:
Destination of the Month

Saint-Louis

Once the colonial capital of French West Africa, Saint-Louis boasts a world heritage listed old town and lively markets and is a gateway to the Langue de Barbarie National Park.

elements.title: Off the Beaten Path (Wikivoyage recommendations)
elements.contents:
Off the Beaten Path

Erice

Floating above the clouds on Sicily’s western coast, Erice has been a place of pilgrimage for millennia — from an ancient Temple of Venus to the medieval churches that remain open today.

elements.title: Featured Travel Topic (Wikivoyage recommendations)
elements.contents:
Featured Travel Topic

Broken Hill Xplorer

This once-weekly train offers a great affordable and scenic way to travel across the state of New South Wales, from the state capital of Sydney to the small outback mining town of Broken Hill.
